newsitem.title: USA: Questar cites strong EPS in early 1997.
newsitem.headline: Questar cites strong EPS in early 1997.

text.p: Questar Corp said Monday that net income is exceeding its expectations during the first two months of 1997, and that it expects to have a strong 1997, following a 17 percent rise in earnings in 1996 to record levels or $2.39 a share.
The company also said it plans to purchase up to $60 million of its common stock on the open market or in privately negotiated transactions over the next two years.
Questar said the initial $20 million phase of the repurchase program would begin immediately.
The company said the stock-repurchase program and its planned $273 million 1997 capital spending program will be funded from strong internal cash flows and short- and long-term borrowing, Cash said.
Questar is an integrated energy-services company with interests in retail natural gas distribution, interstate gas transportation and gas and oil exploration and production.
